currentUserGoal: Fix the broken Options slider and add important tactile SFX for grass touching with a working SFX volume slider.
workCompleted: Expanded the redesign Options panel so Music and SFX have separate readable slider rows instead of one cramped music-only control.
Reworked Options slider drag state so music and SFX use explicit targets and shared pointer-to-volume math.
Added a separate persisted SFX volume to the redesign scene using the existing audio settings helpers.
Mirrored SFX volume into the DOM agent/options layer as `redesign-sfx-volume-range` and added it to readable debug output.
Reused the existing procedural `AudioSystem` for redesign root touch SFX, with grass texture mapped to different touch sound profiles.

Added first-pass SFX for first touch, normal root touches, wounded/root seal feedback, blocked/recovering feedback, Dew Pulse, Root Salve, Tiny Sprinkler purchase, wound opening, and Memory purchases.
Throttled DOM SFX slider preview chirps so range input dragging does not spam sounds.
Documented the SFX slider and new options control in the core redesign docs.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 30 Vitest tests, TypeScript, and Vite production build.
